slides.texte_overlay:
weird habits that make you
instantly calmer

humming

hum a slow tune for a minute when you feel tense. the gentle vibration calms your nervous system, and it's almost impossible to feel panicked while humming.

learning something gentle

giving your anxious mind one calm and beautiful thing to focus on, like a constellation or a painting, gently pulls it away from the worry it keeps circling.
slides.texte_sophia:
learning something gentle

when i feel anxious, i spend 5 minutes on one lesson in the Sophia app, a constellation or a painting. focusing on something beautiful calms me down so quickly.

slides.texte_overlay:
holding something cold

hold an ice cube or a cold glass in your hand for a minute. the strong sensation pulls your attention out of your racing thoughts and back into your body.

naming five things

name five things you can see, four you can hear and three you can touch. this simple game anchors you in the present moment and quietens anxious thoughts.

slowing your breath out

breathe in for four seconds and out for eight. a long breath out tells your body it's safe, and your heart rate starts to slow down in under a minute.
